# Enclos à silex blanc — proposition visuelle v1

## Prompt

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: original fantasy bestiary narrative illustration. Create a detailed cinematic painterly image of an ENCLOS, a non-living but distinctly animal-like magical creature of protection, installed in the north gateway of an original medieval fortress. A squat ox-sized pale flint creature rests in a niche DIRECTLY ABOVE the gateway, its coherent central body clearly visible. Exactly SIX thick articulated anchoring legs descend along the two stone doorjambs, three on each side, claws embedded into masonry. White sinewy filaments span between the anchoring limbs and support a nearly transparent continuous membrane covering the entire doorway. The creature is mineral and sinewy, with white flint armored nodules and thick load-bearing joints, no human face, no humanoid silhouette, no technological machinery in its anatomy. It has visible compressed cushion-like receiving organs near the joints. It is instinctive, strange, solemn, morally neutral, not an evil demon. Scene action: a wooden medieval handcart loaded with sacks has rolled against the membrane at the lower center. The front of the cart presses a shallow dent into the translucent surface; radial white fibers pull taut from the contact toward the six legs. The barrier is colorless and subtly refractive, stretched skin-like film with fine white seams, NOT a glowing blue forcefield or opaque wall. Physical force is legible: bent foreleg joints, claws straining, fresh cracks and stone dust around ONE loosened anchoring claw that is reaching toward an adjacent mortar joint. View from outside the gate at a slight three-quarter angle, wide enough to see the complete creature above, all six legs, the whole doorway and the cart. Fortress courtyard glimpsed through membrane. Weathered medieval stone, tactile chalky flint, fibrous connective tissue, worn cart wood. A simple medieval winch and rope attached to two neighboring legs sits at one side of the gateway, secondary detail, unused. No people needed. Cool diffuse daylight with warmer light beyond the gate; atmosphere of tragic grandeur and believable material constraints. High-end fantasy creature concept art with beautiful complex functional anatomy and clear composition. No text, no labels, no symbols floating in the air, no watermark. Proposed visual anatomy.
